question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are marked as ​€, ₭, ₮, ₴, ₹, ₾, Select the symbol that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '₾'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c1016d95f0577e8fac3b68ac372b59c62075e38c7f207aee601ac91d72d5935.png]
solution:
Given: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c1016d95f0577e8fac3b68ac372b59c62075e38c7f207aee601ac91d72d5935.png] 

Logic: **If two dice have have the same two face values in the given image, then third number is opposite to each other.**

In given figure,

₭ and ₹ are common.

So, **the number opposite to ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83cd0de872f2af5746e152e4d70fc1d8da527936e59873eee291309c716c0dd4.png] ** is ₮.**

Hence, **"**₮**"** is the correct answer.
